summary:
福特 EPS 0.66 美元暴超預期257%、營收年增6.4%，成本改善與 Pro 商用業務驅動獲利大躍進。
• EPS 0.66 美元，暴超預期 256.64%，獲利大幅改善
• 營收 432.5 億美元，年增 6.38%
• Ford Pro 商用車與服務維持高獲利
• 成本控管與品質改善初見成效
ai_view:
訊號正向但須驗證持續性：EPS 暴超預期幅度極大，部分反映去年同期低基期與成本改善，搭配營收正成長，顯示 Ford Pro 商用業務獲利引擎強勁。短期股價有望受激勵。中期關鍵在電動車虧損能否收斂、保固/品質成本改善是否可持續、關稅對成本的衝擊，以及股息維持能力。追蹤 Ford Pro 利潤率與 Model e 虧損趨勢。

需留意：電動車事業（Model e）持續鉅額虧損；汽車業週期性、關稅與保固/召回成本風險；獲利暴增的基期效應，須觀察可持續性

summary_en:
Ford crushed EPS at $0.66, beating by 257% with 6.4% revenue growth, driven by cost gains and the Pro commercial business.
• EPS of $0.66 beat by 256.64%, a major earnings improvement
• Revenue of $43.25B grew 6.38%
• Ford Pro commercial vehicles and services sustain high profit
• Cost control and quality improvements starting to pay off

ai_view_en:
Signal is positive but sustainability needs validation: the massive EPS beat partly reflects a low year-ago base and cost gains, and with positive revenue growth, it shows Ford Pro as a strong profit engine. Near term the stock should be encouraged. Mid term, the keys are whether EV losses narrow, whether warranty/quality cost gains are durable, tariff impact on costs, and dividend sustainability. Track Ford Pro margins and Model e loss trends.

Watch：EV unit (Model e) continues large losses; Cyclicality, tariffs and warranty/recall cost risk; Earnings surge may reflect a low base; sustainability uncertain
beat_or_miss: 超預期：EPS 暴超預期 256.64%、營收年增 6.38%，獲利大幅優於估計。
